# Finality Market Intelligence (Cardano)

> Pay-per-call market, AI, and Cardano on-chain APIs. Settlement: ADA (lovelace) on Cardano Preprod via x402.

## Cardano payment rail
- Network: cardano:preprod
- Asset: lovelace (ADA)
- Protocol: x402 v2 exact scheme (@odatano/x402)
- Wallets: CIP-30 (Lace, Nami on Preprod)
- Settlement: in-process localFacilitator + Blockfrost (no external facilitator URL)

## Platform
- Website: https://finality.accuracy.wtf
- Local UI: http://localhost:3000/explore
- Local merchant: http://127.0.0.1:4021
- Proxy: /api/x402 → merchant

## Docs (repo)
- README.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/final-product.md
- docs/api-endpoints.md
- lib/cardano/README.md

## Discovery
- GET /v1/catalog — prices and operation IDs
- GET /v1/openapi.json
- POST /pay/intent — unsigned tx for CIP-30 signTx
